title: A must do!!
text:
Overall, this tour was amazing! It was great seeing everything and not having to stand in line. This excursion is a must do in Barcelona!

Marcel is amazing tour guide. He was extremely passionate and knowledgeable about the history and architecture of Gaudi. He is very welcoming and kind. We really appreciated his background and knowledge of the subject. We would recommend this tour to our friends and family. We do tours like all around the world and Marcel is one of the best tour guides we’ve ever had!

title: Great Tour with Expert Guide
text: We were fortunate to have historian Philippe as our guide. He had a wealth of knowledge about Gaudi, Park Guell, and La Sagrada Família, as well as how they fit in with the history of Barcelona. We wouldn’t have gotten half as much from the visits without Philippe’s expertise, and the La Sagrada Família stained glass windows illuminated by the afternoon light were out of this world. I highly recommend this tour!
author: 642nancys

title: A must do tour in Barcelona!
text: Our guide, Berta, was incredible. She really made the experience worthwhile. We felt like we would have missed out on so many of the concepts and reasoning behind all of Gaudi’s works had we not had Berta and a tour!
author: Robert_W

title: My head, heart and soul are full
text: My wife and I had a magical experience on this tour .  Our guide Felipe was truly exceptional as he navigated Sagrada Família’s crazy crowds with ease while giving us all the information and symbolism we could handle.  Highly recommended.
